title: Gold Years Account Referral Program
summary: Explains the Gold Years Account Referral Program: referrers (who have had Rho-Bank checking status for 30 days) earn $50 per successful referral, while eligible friends/family (age 62+) receive a $75 welcome bonus, capped at 6 referral bonuses per calendar year. The referred person must deposit $1,000 within 90 days of opening.
faqs: How much do I earn for each successful Gold Years referral?
What welcome bonus does my referred friend/family member receive?
Is there a yearly limit on referral bonuses? (How many?)
What are the eligibility requirements for me to make a valid referral?
What does the referred person need to do to get the $75 bonus, and by when?
Where do I find my personalized referral link and track referrals?
keywords: Max 6 referral bonuses per calendar year
